recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the variable extension into core for FHIR-25512; handle any future changes to the variable extension in the FHIR Extension Pack repository.
issue_request: FHIR-25512 was Published as Persuasive for R5. It reported that the variable extension did not require variables' Expression.name values, and the accepted resolution was to add a constraint on the extension's Expression value so Expression.name is required.
initial_application: Core history explicitly applied the issue: f03a153a3fd50b4257966231573fea131b6c0fb4 added a MustHaveName constraint with value.name.exists() to source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for the variable extension, and 02d5f0bffcaefadbf7619c9314915307cc4a0444 changed the key from ext-1 to var-1 after a key collision.
additional_context: The variable extension rows were later removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 when extensions were moved out of the R5 core source. Current core still builds general extensions from source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, but that file no longer contains the variable extension or FHIR-25512 constraint. The Extension Pack IG declares package hl7.fhir.uv.extensions, and /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-variable.xml currently defines the variable extension with constraint var-1, severity error, human text "Variable expressions must have a name", expression value.name.exists(), and value[x] typed as Expression. The linked Zulip thread and FHIR SDC minutes match the Jira request and vote. FHIR-25515 came from the same thread but concerns Expression.name's datatype/regex and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The artifact that needs the rule is outside the core checkout and already has the required constraint in the Extension Pack source.

related_jiras.note: Raised from the same Zulip thread about variable names; it changed Expression.name's datatype/regex rather than the variable extension constraint and already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch.
